---
title: "Week 8: When Pregnancy Meets Poverty"
---

## Theme: Maternal Health: Structural Racism, Geographic Disparities, and
Birth Outcomes

The United States spends more on health care than any comparable nation
and has the worst maternal mortality rate among high-income countries.
Black women are more than three times as likely as white women to
experience a pregnancy-related death --- a disparity that persists after
controlling for income, education, and comorbidities. This week we use
the Washington Tracking Network\'s publicly available preterm birth data
to build spatial maps of birth outcome disparities, examining how
geography intersects with race and economic stress to shape the
conditions of birth.

## Classroom Lab Demonstration

**Legal Focus:** Equal Credit Opportunity Act and its failure to prevent
reverse redlining targeting minority neighborhoods for predatory
lending; reproductive rights and data privacy; state and federal
Medicaid coverage rules for prenatal care and their variation by state.

**Health Focus:** Preterm birth (\< 37 weeks gestation) as a leading
cause of infant mortality and lifelong disability; racial disparities in
preterm birth that persist even when controlling for socioeconomic
status; economic stressors (housing instability, foreclosure, eviction)
as physiological stressors affecting birth outcomes.

**Data:** Washington Tracking Network (WTN) --- preterm birth data by
county and by race/ethnicity, available at
fortress.wa.gov/doh/wtn/WTNPortal/home/#!q0=81. Select \'Reproductive
and Birth Outcomes\' \> \'Preterm Birth.\' Download county-level CSV.
Also: CDC Social Vulnerability Index (atsdr.cdc.gov/placeandhealth/svi)
for Washington state; HOLC redlining shapefiles for Seattle/Tacoma
(dsl.richmond.edu/panorama/redlining).

**R Code:** read_csv() to load WTN preterm birth county data;
tigris::counties() to get Washington state county shapefiles;
dplyr::left_join() by county FIPS; ggplot2 geom_sf() choropleth of
preterm birth rates; facet_wrap(\~race_ethnicity) to produce small
multiples by racial group; cowplot::plot_grid() to combine faceted maps.

- Download Washington state county-level preterm birth data by
  race/ethnicity from the Washington Tracking Network
  (fortress.wa.gov/doh/wtn/WTNPortal/home/#!q0=81) --- select
  Reproductive and Birth Outcomes \> Preterm Birth

- Load county shapefile for Washington state using
  tigris::counties(state=\'WA\', cb=TRUE)

- Join preterm birth data to shapefile by county FIPS code; compute
  preterm birth rate per 1,000 births

- Produce a faceted choropleth map with one panel per racial/ethnic
  group (White, Black, Hispanic, AIAN) showing preterm birth rates by
  county

- Overlay WA county HOLC redlining boundaries (Seattle, Tacoma, Spokane)
  to examine whether high-preterm-birth counties correspond to
  historically redlined areas
